answer: Let every identity draw from one shared ocean of verified tasks and leave a plume of completed work behind it: the plume must stay continuous over time, because standing is measured from its unbroken trail, not from a single act. Rewards begin only above a ridge of sustained flow, so a farm that splits its real work capacity across many identities thins every plume at once; each one falls below the ridge and earns nothing, while one honest identity with a full, steady plume keeps earning.
